case_policy: Independent nonce is committed here before outcomes. Route-specific API and case-family annexes will be frozen before independent execution. Nonce and full reproduction cases are revealed only after testing. No seed fishing or replacement of a failing case.

independence.constructor_edits: No verifier edits to constructor source or acceptance rules
independence.shared_host: Procedural agent separation only: filesystem and tools are shared; no OS-enforced holdout secrecy or external certification is claimed
independence.hidden_truth: Constructors are instructed not to inspect verifier holdout inputs or truth; this is not an access-control guarantee
independence.source_binding: Hash actual constructor source, preregistration, independent checker and result bytes; report any changes after freeze

scientific_checks: Reconstruct at least one accepted result per route using independently implemented analytic, exhaustive or cross-solver truth
Test normal, boundary, shifted and inadmissible inputs; acceptance must preserve original purpose including future obligations
Inspect strongest unrestricted conventional comparator and compare matched inputs, information, actions and budgets
Check K2 has a different operational function, not renamed or merely larger K1 work
Check retained means frozen before K2 and compare no-inheritance and equal-content ordinary reuse
Reject unsupported novelty, superiority, physical validation or externally calibrated domain conclusions from authored finite models
Check malformed inputs, nonfinite values and stated abstention conditions where meaningful
Record original failures and repairs with new source identities; no retroactive acceptance relaxation
economic_checks: One canonical JournalAccount plus adaptive Account per trajectory; read-only summaries must not create a second spendable ledger
Use exact cash, costs and obligations; no negative unprotected cash, silent financing, reset, pooled seeds or duplicated deployment/customer
Distinguish initial seed, external financing, recognized revenue, collected cash and earned funds; a promise or receivable cannot fund a current action
Reserve complete fulfillment, support, maintenance, refunds and tax obligations; reserves are not duplicated expenses and obligations cannot disappear on halt
Charge research and failed attempts, production, verification, correction, rights, acquisition, overhead, maintenance, taxes and financing as declared
Buyer choice uses information available then; refusal, competent competitors and independent financing refusal are valid outcomes
Independent replay of selected public account exports and exact rolling365 start/end dates; short-horizon annualization and five-year cumulative earnings cannot pass the target
USD100000 and USD1billion are separate comparison seeds/scenarios, never pooled; test nonentry, staging and financing refusal where implemented
Trace aggregate scale to explicit smaller executed trajectories, with actual artifacts separated from modeled units
No externally validated demand, actual commerce, full autonomous human-lifecycle advantage or industrial physical qualification is inferred from a software pass
stopping: One finite registered test set per frozen source. Recoverable defects are preserved and repaired prospectively. Close with reproducible result or exact checkpoint; do not rerun seeds until success.
verdict_scope: A passing computational check establishes only its explicit finite contract. Blue Sky admission and USD3billion trailing-year profit remain separate evidence requirements.
